To find the day of the week 567 days after Saturday, September 19, 2009, I need to determine how many complete weeks that is, plus any remaining days.

567 ÷ 7 = 81 remainder 0

Since 567 = 81 × 7 exactly, this means 567 days later is exactly 81 complete weeks.

Since days of the week repeat every 7 days, adding a multiple of 7 days returns you to the same day of the week.

Therefore, 567 days after Saturday is **Saturday**.
